## What would you like WAMBLE to do

Describe the tool or improvement you have in mind.

## Why it would help

What problem does it solve, and who would use it. The format "I think this would
help someone who is trying to do X" works well.

## How you imagine it working

A rough sketch of the command or behavior, if you have one.

## Alternatives

Anything you already tried, or other ways to solve the same problem.
